name: Malpartida de Cáceres (Spain)
description: Square blue flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Malpartida de Cáceres (a lion and a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Malpartida de Cáceres; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Malpartida de Cáceres arms — lion and castle on red
